author: Cleo Abram
description:
There are technically three planets in the goldilocks zone of our own solar system. 

Mars has garnered a ton of attention as a place that might be host to alien life. We’ve successfully landed rovers and sampled the martian atmosphere and ground, but Venus largely remains a mystery. 

This earth-sized planet is known for being an extreme hellscape, but in recent years NASA and others have decided it’s time to take a closer look at our evil twin.

#venus #space #NASA #science #aliens
title: Is There Life on Venus?
